newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sales thin, $114/dressed-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sales thin, $114/dressed-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Tuesday were slow, with a small number of lower quality cattle trading at $114.0 per cwt on a dressed basis, market sources said.
About 200 head were sold at the $114.00 level but most owners were asking $116.00 to $117.00/dressed.
On a live basis, bids if $72.00 were passed with cattle feeders generally asking $74.00, sources said.
Trading was expected to pick up by Thursday at steady to higher prices amid tight supplies of market-ready cattle.
